data.title: Add interactive mode for list command
data.body:
## Goal

Add an interactive/TUI mode for `docket list` that allows selecting and acting on bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket list --interactive` or `docket list -i` enters interactive mode
- [ ] Arrow keys navigate bug list
- [ ] Enter key shows the selected bug (`docket show`)
- [ ] `w` key starts work on selected bug (`docket work`)
- [ ] `a` key approves selected bug
- [ ] `q` or Escape exits interactive mode
- [ ] Filter keys still work (show only approved, etc.)

## Context

Currently you have to remember bug IDs to act on them. Interactive mode with fzf-style selection would be much faster for browsing and acting on bugs.

Consider using `dialoguer` (already a dependency) or `ratatui` for TUI.

## Log

- 2026-01-14: Implemented interactive mode using dialoguer's console crate. Added -i/--interactive flag to list command. Supports arrow keys (and j/k vim keys) for navigation, Enter to show bug details, w to start work, a to approve, and q/Escape to quit. All existing filters work in interactive mode.
